description:
The terminal renders with the DOM without WebGL2. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-webgl; terminals render with xterm.js, on a phone screen at device scale 1, and the browser offers no WebGL2 (canvas getContext("webgl2") returns null).
1. Navigate to /c/term-webgl and open the Terminal workspace tool: phones keep workspace tools in the overflow menu, so click the visible button with aria-label exactly "More options", then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose text starts with "Terminal".
2. The terminal, '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]', should become visible (wait up to 30s).
3. The terminal's ".xterm-rows" should contain "$".
